verdict.rationale: IndusLaw's Employment & Pensions page covers 'structuring of compensation and benefits' and a dedicated publication analyzes ESOP taxation (Flipkart buyback ruling) for India, showing genuine engagement with employee equity issues. However, as an India-only firm (offices limited to Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Mumbai), there's no evidence of designing or advising on UK EMI or German VSOP/ESOP schemes, and no dedicated 'equity plan design' service page describing option-plan drafting for founders. Missing for 10: explicit option-plan/ESOP design service description, any cross-border scheme content (UK EMI, German VSOP), and founder-facing guidance beyond tax-dispute analysis.
